newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian public sector workers urge PM to quit.
newsitem.headline: Croatian public sector workers urge PM to quit.

text.p: Trade unions of Croatian public service workers urged Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa to resign on Tuesday for ignoring their demands for higher wages, state news agency HINA reported.
"Matesa promised the wages of workers in public sector would be raised in July and it never happened," Vilim Ribic, of the Union of Research Workers told HINA.
The unions had signed a collective agreement in principle with the government."It's Matesa's fault that the agrement is not being observed and he should therefore resign," Ribic said.

The unions, whose members are among the most poorly paid in the country, have called a peaceful protest rally for Wednesday in Zagreb, the agency said. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
